opening.argument: The description offers a $25 Visa gift card to a random subscriber and sets out the entry conditions: like the video, subscribe, and comment about Red Dead Redemption 2. Those are ordinary engagement actions for a promotional giveaway, with no payment demand, credential request, or financial-participation requirement in the supplied text. The title presents the card as free, and a gift card with Visa branding is visible. Neither the text nor the frame establishes whether the card is valid, the giveaway is fulfilled, or any recipient receives it.
